suggested_fix: No security fix is needed. This is a userspace kselftest for close_range(). All array accesses stay within open_fds[0..100]: the F_DUPFD_QUERY loop runs i < 100 and reads open_fds[i + 1], and the read after the loop on line 62 uses i == 100. One robustness change would help: the hard-coded close(57), close(78) and similar calls assume those fd numbers fall in the opened range. Using close(open_fds[k]) instead would make the test more reliable, but this is not a security issue.
